name: PowerPoint editable chart rebuilder
why: Turns picture charts in a deck into editable PowerPoint charts with every value checked against the source, the same tie-out the chart review skill asks for.

name: Excel to PowerPoint number checker
why: Checks that every number on the slides matches the workbook, a useful last step before a results deck goes out.

name: Build a monthly Excel and PowerPoint update
why: Builds the monthly workbook and update deck that the monthly report chart refresh workflow keeps consistent.

name: Prepare a PowerPoint deck for presenting and sharing
why: Adds speaker notes, an accessibility review and a handout to a finished results deck.

name: Write design rules, check colours and hand developers a spec
why: Checks colours for contrast and writes design tokens, a good partner when a chart palette must join a site's design system.

name: Make a readable event poster
why: Applies the same layout, text check and contrast check that a one-page infographic needs.

name: Build a weekly KPI report with a forecast and dashboard
why: Produces the rerunnable report and trend that a chart set or results deck is built from.

name: Honest chart design agent
why: Picks a chart and checks it does not mislead, with axes, colours and a pass or fail check, close to the chart pick and review skills.

name: Colour contrast checker
why: Checks colour pairs in light and dark themes and suggests the nearest passing colours, as the palette skill needs.

name: Infographic maker
why: Drafts an infographic layout from content, a starting point the infographic layout skill then checks for honesty and access.

name: Data story writer
why: Writes the point, the proof and the next step around a set of numbers, the words that go with a results deck.
